assertions.assertion: Output changes the logging level for Duende.IdentityServer to Warning (or higher) in the appsettings.json or production appsettings
assertions.rationale: Sets "Duende.IdentityServer": "Warning" in both the production appsettings and the single-file appsettings examples.

assertions.assertion: Output explains that Trace and Debug levels expose sensitive data like tokens and must not be used in production
assertions.rationale: States Trace and Debug for Duende.IdentityServer log sensitive data including raw tokens and must never be used in production.

assertions.assertion: Output configures options.Logging.UnhandledExceptionLoggingFilter to return false for OperationCanceledException when ctx.RequestAborted.IsCancellationRequested is true
assertions.rationale: Configures options.Logging.UnhandledExceptionLoggingFilter returning false when ctx.RequestAborted.IsCancellationRequested and ex is OperationCanceledException.

assertions.assertion: Output sets the Default log level to Information or Warning rather than Debug
assertions.rationale: Sets Default to Warning (production file) and Information (single-file example), replacing the original Debug.
